hook: A small child rode this cable up out of Hurricane Eta's flood.
narration: A woman and a small child rode this cable up out of Hurricane Eta's floodwater.
This was San Pedro Sula, Honduras, in November 2020.
A U.S. Army Black Hawk crew from Joint Task Force Bravo was hoisting survivors above the flood.
The crew chief works the hoist from the open door.
outcome: The Black Hawk crew pulled them safely inside the helicopter.
title: Child hoisted out of Hurricane Eta flood
description:
A U.S. Army HH-60 Black Hawk crew with the 1-228th Aviation Regiment, Joint Task Force-Bravo, hoisted Hurricane Eta flood survivors at San Pedro Sula, Honduras, on Nov. 7, 2020.

Footage: U.S. Army video by Staff Sgt. Elijaih Tiggs, Joint Task Force Bravo, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/772088/jtf-bravo-rescues-honduran-family

question_comment: Could you hold on to a child on a cable that high?

facts.claim: Black Hawk crew of JTF-Bravo hoists rescued Hondurans above Eta floodwaters at San Pedro Sula
facts.source_quote: U.S. Army HH-60 Black Hawk helicopter crew assigned to the 1-228th Aviation Regiment, Joint Task Force-Bravo hoists rescued Hondurans above floodwaters from Hurricane Eta at San Pedro Sula, Honduras, Nov. 7, 2020.
